name: a stored file: all four reported, the name without its prefix
because: cloudfilenode.ts :75-84 (taken, all four sent); :36-41 (everything up to the first underscore dropped)

name: a stored file with no prefix and neither optional field: Name whole, Content Type and Size never sent
because: cloudfilenode.ts :40 (one part: the name as it is); :55, :64 (the getters hand undefined — never sent, C3)

name: a plain object with a stored file's keys is dropped; a stored file after it is taken (the control)
null after a stored file keeps the stored file
because: cloudfilenode.ts :76-78 — any other value leaves the held file

name: a second stored file replaces the first; a field it lacks keeps its old value on the wire
because: cloudfilenode.ts :79-83 — all four flagged; the second has no Size, `undefined` is never sent (C3)

name: a PocketBase file read back from a record (no uploaded name): Name is its stored name whole (v2, C52)
because: cloudfilenode.ts: a file addressed by a target is not prefixed, so it is not chopped (P109 ISL-030, P107-C52 ruled "Keep the real name"); v1 dropped up to the first underscore and showed the random suffix

name: a PocketBase file Upload File made: Name is the name it was uploaded as (v2, C52)
because: cloudfilenode.ts: `getFilename` first (P109 ISL-030, P107-C52 ruled "Keep the real name")

name: a Directus file: Name is the name it was uploaded as, not the UUID (v2, C52)
because: cloudfilenode.ts: `getFilename` first — Directus reports `filename_download` (P109 ISL-030, P107-C52)
